description: This PHP class defines the structure and behavior of an HTML element definition used in the HTMLPurifier library. It contains properties for attributes, child definitions, content models, and methods for merging definitions. It is part of an HTML sanitization and validation system.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ElementDef
classes.description: Represents an HTML element definition, including attributes, child definitions, and content models, used for sanitizing and validating HTML content.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new standalone element definition with specified content model, type, and attributes.

methods.name: mergeIn
methods.description: Merges another element definition into this one, with the incoming definition's values taking precedence.
